name: HVP-DINO stage 1 frozen-state entropy selection audit
scope: Official late DINO checkpoint, fixed-state measurement only. No training, backward, stage 2/3, claims about HVP trajectory or gains, or assumption that KL is better. CE=KL+H is known, not a contribution.

safe_load.allowed_key_normalization: Remove one leading module. prefix, if present; reject collisions.

data.name: Caltech101
data.license_gate: Confirm research use from official metadata/license; do not treat empty license display as prohibition or proof of CC BY 4.0.
data.sample_rule: Sort relative POSIX image paths within each sorted class; use NumPy PCG64(20261030) sequential choice without replacement for each class; sort selected paths; save manifest before model results; no damaged-image replacements.

views.seed_encoding: UTF-8 compact JSON array [20261030,relative_posix_path,draw_index,view_id], ensure_ascii=false, separators=(comma,colon); SHA256 digest first 8 bytes interpreted unsigned big-endian. draw_index is 0 or 1. Seed each view independently.

candidates.local_subsets: Unordered choose 8 of 16, itertools.combinations(range(16),8), lexicographic order
candidates.sampling: choice(51480,128,replace=False), then sort; shared across all images, draws, temperatures, scores; no screening

score.K: Same 18 ordered teacher/student terms with KL(q||p), divided by 18
score.winner: exact argmax; first lexicographic candidate on ties
score.deltas: C,Hbar,K of CE winner minus respective mean over all 128 candidates; equal image/draw weighting
score.local_negative_control: Deduplicate all local subsets in main table; pair every unique subset with fixed A0,B0; reuse outputs. Both T: strict change rate=0 and identity max error<=1e-6.

inference.bootstrap: Percentile 2.5/97.5; resample original images within each class; two draws bound; never bootstrap candidates as independent
inference.RH: sumDeltaH/sumDeltaC; no clipping/epsilon; zero denominator retained and CI marked undetermined
primary_all_required: all numerical and negative controls pass
inference.sensitivity: T=.07 cannot rescue primary failure; no sweep

budget.throughput_gate: First 16 images x 2 draws = 32 full pools; synchronize; include warmup and CPU waits; project remaining pools with 25% reserve. Abort RESOURCE-INCONCLUSIVE if full 2020 pools plus report cannot finish. Do not reduce sample size/resolution.

delivery: Chinese report, source/data/weight/protocol hashes, tests, CSV, budget ledger, verified local archive. No commit, push, public upload. Preserve history. No actual gradient-consistency claim.
